title: 第529章 诸界星域第528章 天命聚会
lines: 循着那道紧急征召令传递而来的星图坐标，云澈、青帝、冥皇、羽曦四人，以天命至尊之能，在无尽虚空中穿梭。
这一次的旅程，远比从万族星域到天命神台更加漫长、更加艰难。
他们穿越了无数扭曲的时空乱流，跨过了数条横亘星海的恐怖能量带，甚至在某些区域，感受到了连天命至尊都需小心避让的、足以湮灭星辰的诡异法则风暴。
旅途之中，他们也遇到了其他从不同方向赶赴同一目的地的流光。
那些流光气息各异，强横无比，至少都是天命至尊级别，有些甚至晦涩深邃，让云澈四人都感到隐隐的压力，那很可能是老牌的天命至尊，甚至……更高层次的存在！
彼此间大多只是遥遥感应，并无交流，但一种同赴战场的肃杀与凝重氛围，已然弥漫开来。
不知穿越了多少荒芜星域，越过了多少残破的世界壁垒碎片，某一日，前方的虚空骤然变得“明亮”
起来。
并非光明星域那种柔和的光辉，而是一种难以言喻的、由无数庞大世界规则、高浓度能量、以及浩瀚文明气息交织形成的、无比“厚重”
与“拥挤”
的感觉。
仿佛穿过了一层无形的薄膜，眼前的景象豁然开朗。
一片难以用语言形容其万一的、浩瀚到令人窒息的星空，展现在他们面前。
这里的星辰并非均匀分布，而是聚合成一团团、一簇簇，每一团都仿佛是一个巨大无比的、由无数世界、星云、乃至破碎大陆和奇异天体构成的“超级星域”
粗略感应，这样的“超级星域”
集群，竟然有成百上千个！
它们之间相隔遥远，却又被一种更加宏大、更加稳固的时空结构隐隐联系在一起，共同构成了这片名为“诸界星域”
的恐怖疆域。
与万族星域相比，这里的能量层次普遍高出不止一筹，天地法则更加清晰稳固，却也更加复杂多变。
虚空中，时刻流淌着来自不同“超级星域”
的、属性迥异的能量潮汐与法则波动。
仅仅站在边缘，云澈便能感受到不下万种截然不同的文明气息！
有的炽热如恒星内核，有的冰冷如万古玄冰，有的生机勃勃如原始丛林，有的死寂沉沉如亡灵国度，有的锋锐如剑，有的厚重如山，有的灵动如风，有的诡异莫测难以名状……
“这里……便是诸界星域？”
羽曦碧眸中闪过一丝震撼，她感知到的“速度”
法则在这里都似乎变得更加活跃，但也受到了更多其他法则的制约。
“万界交汇，文明如林……果然名不虚传。”
青帝深吸一口气，感应着那浩瀚如海的生机与死亡交替的韵律，眼中神光湛湛。
冥皇沉默不语，但周身幽暗的气息微微波动，显然也被这片星域的浩瀚与深不可测所触动。
这里死亡与寂灭的气息同样浓烈，而且更加古老、更加深邃。
云澈银眸中时光之痕流转，他看到的更多。
这片星域，看似浩瀚繁华，但在那繁华之下，他隐约感觉到了一种紧绷的、肃杀的气氛。
许多“超级星域”
外围，都有强大的能量屏障与防御工事，星空中不时有庞大的、充满战争气息的舰队或强者队伍呼啸而过，方向明确地朝着某个区域汇集。
空气中，似乎还弥漫着一丝极淡的、令人不安的、充满“毁灭”
与“贪婪”
的陌生气息。
那道征召令的坐标，指向的是这片浩瀚星域边缘地带，一个特殊的、仿佛由无数块破碎大陆、星空堡垒、巨型传送阵拼凑而成的、庞大无比的、散发着混乱而繁忙气息的“枢纽”
这，便是“万界枢纽”
，诸界联军抵抗“吞噬族”
的前线指挥部与大本营之一。
content_en:
Following the star map coordinates transmitted by the emergency recruitment order, Yun Che, Qing Emperor, Ming Emperor, and Yu Xi shuttled through the endless void with the supreme power of destiny.
This journey is far longer and more difficult than from the Ten Thousand Races Star Territory to the Destiny Platform.
They passed through countless distorted time and space turbulences, crossed several terrifying energy belts across the star sea, and even felt the strange law storm in some areas that even the Supreme Destiny had to be careful to avoid, which was enough to annihilate the stars.
During the journey, they also met other streamers rushing to the same destination from different directions.
Those streams of light had different auras and were extremely powerful. At least they were all at the level of the Supreme Destiny. Some were even obscure and profound, which made Yun Che and the four of them feel a faint pressure. They were probably the veteran Supreme Destiny, or even... a higher level existence!
Most of them only sense each other remotely and have no communication, but a solemn and solemn atmosphere of going to the battlefield together has spread.
I don’t know how many desolate star fields I have traveled through, how many broken world barrier fragments I have passed, but one day, the void in front of me suddenly became "bright"
Get up.
It is not the soft brilliance of the light star field, but an indescribable and incomparable "thickness" formed by the interweaving of countless huge world rules, high concentration of energy, and the vast breath of civilization.
and "crowded"
feeling.
As if passing through an invisible membrane, the scene in front of me suddenly became clear.
A starry sky that was difficult to describe in words and so vast that it was suffocating was displayed in front of them.
The stars here are not evenly distributed, but gathered into clusters. Each cluster seems to be an extremely huge "super star field" composed of countless worlds, nebulae, even broken continents and strange celestial bodies.
Roughly speaking, such a "super star field"
There are hundreds or even thousands of clusters!
They are far apart, but they are vaguely connected by a larger and more stable space-time structure, which together form this area called "Star Fields of All Realms"
Territory of terror.
Compared with the Ten Thousand Races Star Territory, the energy level here is generally much higher, and the laws of heaven and earth are clearer and more stable, but also more complex and changeable.
In the void, streams from different "super star fields" flow all the time.
Energy tides and law fluctuations with different attributes.
Just standing on the edge, Yun Che could feel the atmosphere of no less than ten thousand completely different civilizations!
Some are as hot as the core of stars, some are as cold as eternal black ice, some are as vibrant as primeval jungles, some are as dead and silent as the kingdom of the undead, some are as sharp as swords, some are as thick as mountains, some are as agile as wind, and some are weird and indescribable...
"This...is the Star Realm of All Realms?"
A flash of shock flashed in Yu Xi's green eyes, the "speed" she perceived
The laws seem to become more active here, but they are also restricted by more other laws.
“Thousands of worlds meet, and civilizations are like forests… It truly deserves its reputation.”
Qingdi took a deep breath, feeling the rhythm of the vast sea of life and death alternating with a gleaming light in his eyes.
The Hades Emperor was silent, but the dark aura around him fluctuated slightly, and he was obviously touched by the vastness and unfathomable depth of this star field.
The smell of death and annihilation is equally strong here, older and deeper.
Traces of time flowed in Yun Che's silver eyes, and he saw more.
This star field seemed vast and prosperous, but under that prosperity, he vaguely felt a tight and chilling atmosphere.
Many "super star fields"
There are powerful energy barriers and defenses on the outside. From time to time, huge, warlike fleets or strong teams roar past in the starry sky, converging towards a certain area in a clear direction.
There seems to be a very faint, disturbing and full of "destruction" in the air.
and "greed"
The strange smell.
The coordinates of the recruitment order pointed to the edge of this vast star field, a special "hub" that seemed to be made up of countless broken continents, starry sky fortresses, and giant teleportation arrays. It was huge and exuded a chaotic and busy atmosphere.
This is the "hub of all realms"
, the coalition forces from all realms resisted the "devouring tribe"
One of the frontline headquarters and base camp.
